files.content:
name: mobile-app assistant
version: 1.0.0
schema: v1

models:
  - name: main
    provider: anthropic
    model: claude-sonnet-4-5
    roles:
      - chat
      - edit
  - name: autocomplete
    provider: ollama
    model: qwen2.5-coder:1.5b
    roles:
      - autocomplete

rules:
  - Use TypeScript strict mode.
  - Match the existing navigation patterns in src/navigation/.

context:
  - provider: file
  - provider: diff

Mobile-app is a React Native (Expo) project.

- Never edit files under ios/ or android/ directly; they are generated.
- Use the design tokens in src/theme.ts, no inline hex colors.
- Screens live in src/screens/, one component per file.
